notes:
• Fixed: choosing "HyperOS wallpaper" in "Change wallpaper" didn't change the desktop. The previous picture stayed behind it. The desktop now shows your HyperOS wallpaper right away, in both macOS and Windows mode.
• Removed "System wallpaper (HyperOS)…" from the desktop menu. It did nothing on HyperOS, and it was only about the HyperOS wallpaper, not TabStation. Use "Same as HyperOS" in "Change wallpaper…" to show your HyperOS wallpaper on the TabStation desktop.
• In "Change wallpaper", "HyperOS wallpaper" is now called "Same as HyperOS", because the TabStation desktop just shows your current HyperOS wallpaper and doesn't change it.
• Smoother macOS ↔ Windows switching: after you confirm, the "Switching appearance…" screen stays until the new desktop and wallpaper are ready, then takes you straight to the desktop in the new mode. No more brief freeze, and no need to tap "Back to Desktop".
• Fixed: when Settings was open as a floating window (from the taskbar), "Back to Desktop" or switching mode could freeze, flash the HyperOS home screen or play two transitions. Settings now just closes and you're back on the desktop.
• Fixed: a picture chosen with "Upload picture…" could end up as "My picture" for the other mode if the mode changed while the picker was open. It now always goes to the mode you were in when you opened the picker.
• All six built-in wallpapers are now realistic 4K landscapes rendered for TabStation:
  - macOS: Dusk (mountains at sunset), Mist (misty lake at dawn), Ocean (open sea with sun glitter)
  - Windows: Lake (alpine lake with mirror reflections, was Bloom), Aurora (northern lights over snowy mountains), Dunes (desert dunes, was Prism)
• From 2.18.9: built-in 4K wallpapers (macOS: Dusk, Mist, Ocean · Windows: Bloom, Aurora, Prism) and a "Change wallpaper…" gallery from the desktop menu and Settings.

Requires Android 10+. Shizuku is recommended. Install over the previous version; settings are kept. TabStation updates itself from Settings → Version & updates.
